comments.text: Happy 8th Anniversary to Better Now! I was only 9 when this song had released in October 2018. I remember when this song was all over the radio and was played EVERYWHERE. Time went by way too fast. This song will bring back memories of my family and me going on vacations when we went to San Diego, CA, and Destin, FL for the first and second time. This song was playing when the sun was setting when we were by the beach. We went to go get ice cream and walked along the boardwalk when it was night by the city. I miss those days. (This was in Destin, FL btw). Time went by so fast, I know this won't make any sense but in 2022, four years after this song was released, the family I went on so many vacations that year, In April we went to Outer Banks, NC and Norfolk, VA, in May, we went to Aruba, in June, we went to Barbados, and in July, we went to Orlando, FL, only just my mom and sister and me to go see my cousins and to go to Disney World, this song was playing during every trip and now in 2025, I'm getting nostalgia from 3 years ago and from 2017 - 2018. I seriously can't believe it's been nearly a decade since this released. I remember when this said 5 years ago. October 5th, 2018 - October 5th, 2026.
